public_rationale: The reliability criticism has contemporary support, and the same period also produced evidence of broad, sometimes human-level capabilities. These findings do not settle the complete standard stated in the post. Treating any hallucination as disqualifying would silently replace human-comparable reliability with perfection; treating selected benchmark successes as sufficient would weaken the standard in the opposite direction.
limitations: This does not establish that the models were AGI.
The Microsoft investigation concerns an early GPT-4 version and is not a comprehensive matched human comparison.
The phrase 'classical criteria' does not itself provide an operational threshold.

resourcefulness and reliability comparable to (or beyond) human intelligence
our_interpretation: Use the definition supplied in the surrounding passage; do not assume that 'classical criteria' names a universally accepted test.
The plain reading requires broad adaptability and reliability comparable to ordinary human performance. It does not require error-free performance.
Treat 'current' as the 2023 generation discussed in the post. With no reporting cycle specified, use the current calendar year's evaluations through publication.
The definition is a standard for assessment, not an antecedent of a conditional forecast.
criteria.support_condition: Representative evaluations show that contemporary frontier LLMs substantially fall short of human-comparable flexibility, resourcefulness or reliability across general tasks.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A contemporary LLM demonstrates the stated combination of generality, resourcefulness and human-comparable reliability across a sufficiently broad and representative evaluation.
